title: Q-SPEC-08-seed-fenced-claims: Tokens, expiry and fences on claims in the seed tick
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-08-T05" -- seed/worker/test
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-08 (US-08-R06 to R08): the seed tick's `claims` table is per item with no token, expiry column or fence, and no step renews the heartbeat; `workers/core/claims` has all of them and is not loaded by the seed Worker. Use the claims module for the seed's dispatch and doer so a holder that wakes after its expiry is refused by its stale fence, and a waiting item's claim is renewed while its doer still retries it within the loop-breaker's bound.

size: L

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** the accounting gate and the visibility ratio, which already run as a step of the composition root.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-08-T05" -- seed/worker/test` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
